body:
GREG, 2026-11-27 about 06:17Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #2178, message b8bd2540), verbatim: „moga wznawiac sesje jak chca, jak przestana niech utworza nowa i mnie poinformuja”. It covers both projects, including Coder3 on Windows B.
RULE:
- Teams may resume a session whose queue was paused (for example by a provider refusal) on their own, with no per-session approval. Use TermAl's single-session queue resume.
- If resuming doesn't help, create a new session for the work and inform Greg through Asistant.
- Asistant's conditions: never work around a provider refusal. Report a repeated refusal with its reason. Don't move a refused action elsewhere just to get past the control.
Context: on 2026-11-27, provider refusals paused TermAl's Sol-edfd (04:01Z), Engram::Fable-WinB (session-27) and Engram::Codex-WinB-Coder3 (session-22). Before this word Greg approved each resume one by one (#2173 „Tak możemy spróbować…”, #2176 „tak, wznawiaj”).
